remarks: Lovely and charming home rental in the Cranbury Park neighborhood. Exceptionally well cared for, recently updated and clean as a whistle. Move-in condition. Features three bedrooms on the upper level and a room on the main level which has been used as a bedroom in the past. Washer/dryer is in the basement, and there are also hookups on the main level. Unfinished basement provides additional storage space. Enjoy the pleasures of the outdoors on the lovely front porch and the enclosed rear yard. Convenient for a short bike ride to Cranbury Park and to all local amenities. No pets, no smokers and tenants must carry liability insurance.

facts.laundryLoc: Basement; hook-up on main level as well
